criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Both use the same high-oblique isometric projection and diagonal ground axes.
The plant, upper substation, right town, and lower factory occupy matching frame positions.
different: Only negligible crop-edge and micro-geometry variation is visible; yaw, pitch, and elevation do not materially differ.

evidence.observation: The world is framed from a high isometric angle with matching diagonal roads and four major districts.
Projection, elevation, yaw, and landmark framing closely reproduce the reference view.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both concentrate housing on the right, heavy industry at lower left, and generation assets at upper left.
Road coverage and the balance of occupied versus open land are closely matched.
different: The candidate's central open ground is cleaner and more repetitive, with slightly less fine rubble and roadside clutter.
Minor peripheral building and terrain details differ.

evidence.observation: The central corridor contains irregular rubble, poles, road fragments, and dense ground variation.
The same corridor and industrial mass remain, but open terrain uses more uniform repeated texture.
A dense residential district fills the right side around the hospital and substation.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: The channel follows the same winding lower-left-to-center course and divides the same districts.
Bridge and road crossings attach at closely matching locations.
different: Reference water is broader and more muted, with rougher bank depth; candidate water is darker blue and more smoothly bounded.

evidence.observation: A muted slate-blue channel winds through deep, irregular rubble banks and several crossings.
The channel repeats the same curvature and crossings but has darker water and cleaner bank silhouettes.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Plants, substations, transmission towers, hospital, and housing retain the same relative silhouette sizes.
Tower spacing and facility-to-district proportions match closely.
different: Tiny rooftop and ancillary-outline variations do not materially change the scale hierarchy.

evidence.observation: Upper-left plant stacks, halls, and adjacent towers establish the reference facility scale.
The plant stacks, halls, and towers retain nearly identical relative dimensions.
Hospital, houses, and central substation share a consistent landmark-to-building scale.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use blackened metal, charcoal concrete and soil, restrained gray midtones, and warm amber lamps.
Cyan electrical effects remain coherent against the dark industrial surface treatment.
different: The candidate terrain is darker and more uniformly embossed, while the reference has more varied rubble and brown-gray soil detail.
Candidate edges and cyan accents are slightly crisper and more saturated.

evidence.observation: Ground materials mix irregular rock, soot, soil, metal debris, and soft amber highlights.
The same dark material family is present, but the ground pattern is more repetitive and uniformly black.
Residential roofs and roads retain cohesive charcoal metal, concrete, and amber-window treatment.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Cyan energized conductors and amber planned conductors follow the same major routes.
Lines attach to corresponding towers and substations, preserving clear energized-versus-planned distinction.
different: The candidate conductor strokes are slightly cleaner and more saturated, with small glow and bend variations.

evidence.observation: Cyan routes connect the upper plants and right town, while an amber dashed route crosses the center.
The same network topology, tower attachments, route colors, and planned-line dashes remain readable.
Amber towers are connected by a softly glowing dashed construction route.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use matching industrial chrome across the top bar, left build palette, and right inspector.
Overlay proportions, inspector hierarchy, selected-tool cyan border, and map integration are nearly identical.
different: Candidate Korean labels and the added budget prefix create slightly denser typography than the reference English labels.

evidence.observation: A segmented black-metal top bar presents budget, power, day, and pause status.
The same segmented top-bar geometry and information hierarchy appear with Korean labels.
The right inspector uses a large asset image, capacity readout, meter, and two action buttons.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both strips are independent four-segment chrome bars centered along the bottom edge.
Each gives the second segment a cyan active treatment and uses icons plus compact labels for progression.
different: The candidate bar is wider and typographically denser, with explicit numbered stages and a result check icon versus the reference's compact playback controls.

evidence.observation: A compact four-part playback strip is centered at the bottom, with the second control highlighted cyan.
A wider four-stage event bar clearly shows briefing, active construction, result, and next-stage progression.
